docs.title: patient_billing_summary
docs.text:
[semantic] patient_billing_summary
name: patient_billing_summary
table: unity.gold.patient_billing_summary
grain: one row per encounter (claims left-joined; claim fan-out possible)
primary_key: encounter_id
description: Encounter-grain financials: encounter cost fields plus (when present) claim and payer attributes. This is the ONLY Gold table that carries cost columns (DRD 5.5 isolation).
synonyms:
  - billing
  - claims
  - cost
  - costs
  - financials
  - charges
  - revenue
sensitive_columns:
  - first_name
  - last_name
dimensions:
  -
    name: encounter_id
    column: encounter_id
    type: string
    description: Encounter UUID (natural key); joins to patient_clinical_history.
  -
    name: patient_id
    column: patient_id
    type: string
    description: Patient UUID; joins to patient_summary.
  -
    name: encounter_class
    column: encounter_class
    type: string
    description: Encounter class.
    synonyms:
      - visit type
    sample_values:
      - OUTPATIENT
      - EMERGENCY
      - WELLNESS
  -
    name: provider_name
    column: provider_name
    type: string
    description: Provider name for the encounter.
    synonyms:
      - doctor
      - physician
      - provider
  -
    name: service_date
    column: service_date
    type: date
    description: Claim service date (from the claim; null when there is no claim).
    present_in_data: False
    notes:
      - Null in the current load (no claim rows joined).
  -
    name: claim_status
    column: claim_status
    type: string
    description: Primary claim status.
    present_in_data: False
    notes:
      - Null for every row in the current load.
  -
    name: primary_payer_name
    column: primary_payer_name
    type: string
    description: Primary payer/insurer name.
    synonyms:
      - insurer
      - payer
      - insurance
    present_in_data: False
    notes:
      - Null for every row in the current load — payer analytics return nothing.
  -
    name: secondary_payer_name
    column: secondary_payer_name
    type: string
    description: Secondary payer/insurer name.
    present_in_data: False
    notes:
      - Null for every row in the current load.
measures:
  -
    name: encounter_count
    agg: count_distinct
    expr: encounter_id
    description: Number of distinct encounters (use DISTINCT to avoid claim fan-out double counting).
  -
    name: total_claim_cost
    agg: sum
    expr: total_claim_cost
    description: Total claim cost. Per-row observed 79.26..1453.84.
    synonyms:
      - total cost
      - total charges
      - total spend
  -
    name: total_base_encounter_cost
    agg: sum
    expr: base_encounter_cost
    description: Total base encounter cost. Per-row observed 51.23..498.97.
  -
    name: total_payer_coverage
    agg: sum
    expr: payer_coverage
    description: Total amount covered by payers. Per-row observed 17.95..436.85.
    synonyms:
      - insurance paid
      - covered amount
  -
    name: total_visit_cost
    agg: sum
    expr: total_visit_cost
    description: Total visit cost (base + procedures + medications, computed in Silver).
  -
    name: avg_claim_cost
    agg: avg
    expr: total_claim_cost
    description: Average claim cost per encounter.
  -
    name: total_outstanding
    agg: sum
    expr: outstanding_amount
    description: Total outstanding = primary + secondary + patient responsibility buckets.
    synonyms:
      - outstanding
      - unpaid
      - balance due
    present_in_data: False
    notes:
      - outstanding_amount is 0 for every row in the current load.
notes:
  - Full-overwrite current snapshot; no ds partition.
  - outstanding_amount SUMS three buckets (primary + secondary + patient), not just patient.
  - Grain is per encounter but claims are LEFT-joined on appointment_id = encounter_id; multiple claims per encounter can fan out rows. For encounter-level counts use COUNT(DISTINCT encounter_id).
  - In the current load only the cost fields carry values; claim_id, payer names, claim_status, service_date and outstanding_amount are all null/zero.

docs.title: patient_clinical_history
docs.text:
[semantic] patient_clinical_history
name: patient_clinical_history
table: unity.gold.patient_clinical_history
grain: one row per encounter
primary_key: encounter_id
description: One row per clinical encounter with denormalized patient/provider/organization names and per-encounter roll-up counts (conditions, procedures, medications, observations, immunizations, active care plans).
synonyms:
  - encounter
  - encounters
  - visit
  - visits
  - clinical history
  - appointments
sensitive_columns:
  - first_name
  - last_name
dimensions:
  -
    name: encounter_id
    column: encounter_id
    type: string
    description: Encounter UUID (natural key).
  -
    name: patient_id
    column: patient_id
    type: string
    description: Patient UUID; joins to patient_summary.
  -
    name: encounter_class
    column: encounter_class
    type: string
    description: Encounter class.
    synonyms:
      - visit type
      - encounter type
    sample_values:
      - OUTPATIENT
      - EMERGENCY
      - WELLNESS
    notes:
      - Domain also includes INPATIENT / URGENTCARE; not present in the current load.
  -
    name: encounter_description
    column: encounter_description
    type: string
    description: Human-readable encounter description.
  -
    name: start_date
    column: start_date
    type: timestamp
    description: Encounter start timestamp.
    synonyms:
      - encounter date
      - visit date
      - when
  -
    name: stop_date
    column: stop_date
    type: timestamp
    description: Encounter stop timestamp (may be null).
  -
    name: los_days
    column: los_days
    type: int
    description: Length of stay in days. Observed range -5..6 (negatives are a source data quirk).
    synonyms:
      - length of stay
      - los
      - days in hospital
  -
    name: encounter_duration_hours
    column: encounter_duration_hours
    type: decimal
    description: Encounter duration in hours.
  -
    name: is_30_day_readmission
    column: is_30_day_readmission
    type: boolean
    description: TRUE if this encounter is a 30-day readmission.
    synonyms:
      - readmission
      - readmitted
    sample_values:
      - false
    present_in_data: False
    notes:
      - All FALSE in the current load.
  -
    name: provider_name
    column: provider_name
    type: string
    description: Attending provider name (high cardinality: ~261 distinct).
    synonyms:
      - doctor
      - physician
      - provider
      - clinician
  -
    name: organization_name
    column: organization_name
    type: string
    description: Encounter organization/facility name (~252 distinct).
    synonyms:
      - hospital
      - facility
      - clinic
      - organization
  -
    name: reason_description
    column: reason_description
    type: string
    description: Reason for the encounter.
    present_in_data: False
    notes:
      - Null for every row in the current load.
measures:
  -
    name: encounter_count
    agg: count
    description: Number of encounters (rows).
    synonyms:
      - how many encounters
      - number of visits
      - visit count
  -
    name: distinct_patient_count
    agg: count_distinct
    expr: patient_id
    description: Number of distinct patients with an encounter (290 in current load).
  -
    name: avg_los
    agg: avg
    expr: los_days
    description: Average length of stay in days.
    synonyms:
      - average length of stay
      - mean los
  -
    name: avg_encounter_duration_hours
    agg: avg
    expr: encounter_duration_hours
    description: Average encounter duration in hours.
  -
    name: readmission_rate
    agg: custom
    expr: AVG(CASE WHEN is_30_day_readmission THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
    description: Fraction of encounters that are 30-day readmissions (0..1).
    present_in_data: False
    notes:
      - Evaluates to 0 in the current load.
  -
    name: total_conditions
    agg: sum
    expr: condition_count
    description: Total conditions recorded across encounters (per-encounter 0-8).
  -
    name: total_medications
    agg: sum
    expr: medication_count
    description: Total medications recorded across encounters (per-encounter 0-6).
  -
    name: total_procedures
    agg: sum
    expr: procedure_count
    description: Total procedures across encounters.
    present_in_data: False
    notes:
      - procedure_count is 0 for every encounter in the current load.
  -
    name: total_observations
    agg: sum
    expr: observation_count
    description: Total observations across encounters.
    present_in_data: False
    notes:
      - observation_count is 0 for every encounter in the current load.
  -
    name: total_immunizations
    agg: sum
    expr: immunization_count
    description: Total immunizations across encounters.
    present_in_data: False
    notes:
      - immunization_count is 0 for every encounter in the current load.
  -
    name: total_active_careplans
    agg: sum
    expr: active_careplan_count
    description: Total active care plans across encounters (active = stop_date IS NULL).
    present_in_data: False
    notes:
      - active_careplan_count is 0 for every encounter in the current load.
notes:
  - Full-overwrite current snapshot; no ds partition.
  - active_careplan_count is derived as COUNT(*) WHERE stop_date IS NULL (no careplan_status column).
  - In the current load, procedure/observation/immunization/careplan counts and readmission flags are all zero, and reason_description is null — prefer questions about encounter_class, provider, organization, length of stay, and condition_count.

docs.title: patient_summary
docs.text:
[semantic] patient_summary
name: patient_summary
table: unity.gold.patient_summary
grain: one row per patient (current SCD2 version only)
primary_key: patient_id
description: One row per patient: current demographics plus pre-aggregated clinical roll-ups (active condition / medication counts, allergy flag, encounter recency & count).
synonyms:
  - patient
  - patients
  - member
  - demographics
  - patient profile
  - people
sensitive_columns:
  - first_name
  - middle_name
  - last_name
  - prefix
  - suffix
  - address
  - zip
dimensions:
  -
    name: patient_id
    column: patient_id
    type: string
    description: Patient UUID (natural key).
    synonyms:
      - patient identifier
      - id
  -
    name: first_name
    column: first_name
    type: string
    description: Given name (PHI).
    sensitive: True
  -
    name: last_name
    column: last_name
    type: string
    description: Family name (PHI).
    sensitive: True
  -
    name: patient_status
    column: patient_status
    type: string
    description: Living status of the patient.
    synonyms:
      - living status
      - alive or deceased
      - vital status
    sample_values:
      - ALIVE
      - DECEASED
  -
    name: gender
    column: gender
    type: string
    description: Administrative gender.
    synonyms:
      - sex
    sample_values:
      - MALE
      - FEMALE
    notes:
      - Domain also allows OTHER / UNKNOWN; not present in the current load.
  -
    name: race
    column: race
    type: string
    description: Race category (uppercase, abbreviated).
    sample_values:
      - WHITE
      - BLACK
      - ASIAN
      - HAWAIIAN
      - NATIVE
      - OTHER
  -
    name: ethnicity
    column: ethnicity
    type: string
    description: Ethnicity category.
    sample_values:
      - HISPANIC
      - NONHISPANIC
  -
    name: marital_status
    column: marital_status
    type: string
    description: Marital status as a single-letter code (may be null).
    synonyms:
      - marriage status
    sample_values:
      - M
      - S
      - D
      - W
    notes:
      - Single-letter CODES, not words: M=Married, S=Single, D=Divorced, W=Widowed. Null = unknown.
      - To filter 'married patients' use marital_status = 'M' (see glossary).
  -
    name: calculated_age
    column: calculated_age
    type: int
    description: Age in years as of the current date. Observed range 1-112.
    synonyms:
      - age
      - how old
  -
    name: birth_date
    column: birth_date
    type: date
    description: Date of birth. Observed 1914-12-19 .. 2025-10-10.
    synonyms:
      - dob
      - date of birth
  -
    name: death_date
    column: death_date
    type: date
    description: Date of death; null for living patients (767 non-null in current load).
  -
    name: city
    column: city
    type: string
    description: Residential city.
  -
    name: state
    column: state
    type: string
    description: Residential state.
  -
    name: zip
    column: zip
    type: string
    description: Residential ZIP code (PHI).
    sensitive: True
  -
    name: has_allergy
    column: has_allergy
    type: boolean
    description: TRUE when the patient has one or more recorded allergies.
    synonyms:
      - allergic
      - has allergies
    sample_values:
      - true
      - false
  -
    name: has_30day_readmission_history
    column: has_30day_readmission_history
    type: boolean
    description: TRUE if the patient has any 30-day readmission in history.
    synonyms:
      - readmitted
      - readmission
    sample_values:
      - false
    present_in_data: False
    notes:
      - All FALSE in the current load — no readmissions present.
  -
    name: recent_encounter_class
    column: recent_encounter_class
    type: string
    description: Class of the patient's most recent encounter; null when the patient has no encounter.
    sample_values:
      - OUTPATIENT
      - EMERGENCY
      - WELLNESS
    notes:
      - Null for patients with no encounters (majority in current load).
  -
    name: recent_encounter_date
    column: recent_encounter_date
    type: date
    description: Date of the patient's most recent encounter (null if none).
measures:
  -
    name: patient_count
    agg: count_distinct
    expr: patient_id
    description: Number of distinct patients.
    synonyms:
      - how many patients
      - number of patients
      - patient volume
      - headcount
  -
    name: avg_age
    agg: avg
    expr: calculated_age
    description: Average patient age in years.
    synonyms:
      - mean age
      - average age
  -
    name: patients_with_allergy
    agg: custom
    expr: SUM(CASE WHEN has_allergy THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
    description: Count of patients with at least one recorded allergy.
  -
    name: readmission_patient_rate
    agg: custom
    expr: AVG(CASE WHEN has_30day_readmission_history THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
    description: Fraction of patients with a 30-day readmission in history (0..1).
    present_in_data: False
    notes:
      - Evaluates to 0 in the current load (no readmissions).
  -
    name: total_active_conditions
    agg: sum
    expr: active_condition_count
    description: Total active conditions across patients (per-patient count is 0-5).
  -
    name: avg_active_conditions
    agg: avg
    expr: active_condition_count
    description: Average number of active conditions per patient.
  -
    name: total_active_medications
    agg: sum
    expr: active_medication_count
    description: Total active medications across patients.
    present_in_data: False
    notes:
      - active_medication_count is 0 for every patient in the current load.
  -
    name: total_encounters
    agg: sum
    expr: encounter_count
    description: Sum of lifetime encounter counts (per-patient count is 0-2 in current load).
  -
    name: avg_encounters_per_patient
    agg: avg
    expr: encounter_count
    description: Average lifetime encounters per patient.
notes:
  - Full-overwrite current snapshot; no ds partition.
  - allergies / conditions / medications are ARRAY<STRUCT> columns (not scalar dimensions). Use size()/explode() to query them. conditions[] and medications[] are ACTIVE-only. medications[] is empty for all patients in the current load.
  - active_medication_count, and 30-day readmission history, carry no non-trivial values in the current dataset — prefer patient_summary questions about status, age, gender, race, conditions, allergies, and encounter counts.

docs.title: patient_360_gold
docs.text:
[semantic] patient_360_gold
name: patient_360_gold
description: Semantic model over the Patient 360 Gold layer (unity.gold.patient_summary, patient_clinical_history, patient_billing_summary). Grain, dimensions, measures, joins, metrics, and vocabulary for answering business questions in SQL.
version: 1.0
dialect: Spark SQL
catalog: unity
relationships:
  -
    name: history_to_patient
    from_entity: patient_clinical_history
    from_column: patient_id
    to_entity: patient_summary
    to_column: patient_id
    cardinality: many_to_one
    description: Each encounter belongs to one patient.
  -
    name: billing_to_patient
    from_entity: patient_billing_summary
    from_column: patient_id
    to_entity: patient_summary
    to_column: patient_id
    cardinality: many_to_one
    description: Each billing row belongs to one patient.
  -
    name: billing_to_history
    from_entity: patient_billing_summary
    from_column: encounter_id
    to_entity: patient_clinical_history
    to_column: encounter_id
    cardinality: one_to_one
    description: Billing and clinical history share the encounter grain (join on encounter_id).
metrics:
  -
    name: living_patient_count
    entity: patient_summary
    measure: patient_count
    filter: patient_status = 'ALIVE'
    description: Number of living patients.
    synonyms:
      - how many living patients
      - alive patients
  -
    name: deceased_patient_count
    entity: patient_summary
    measure: patient_count
    filter: patient_status = 'DECEASED'
    description: Number of deceased patients.
    synonyms:
      - how many deceased
      - dead patients
  -
    name: avg_age_by_gender
    entity: patient_summary
    measure: avg_age
    group_by:
      - gender
    description: Average patient age split by gender.
  -
    name: patients_by_race
    entity: patient_summary
    measure: patient_count
    group_by:
      - race
    description: Patient counts by race.
  -
    name: encounters_by_class
    entity: patient_clinical_history
    measure: encounter_count
    group_by:
      - encounter_class
    description: Encounter volume by encounter class.
  -
    name: avg_length_of_stay_by_encounter_class
    entity: patient_clinical_history
    measure: avg_los
    group_by:
      - encounter_class
    description: Average length of stay by encounter class.
  -
    name: readmission_rate
    entity: patient_clinical_history
    measure: readmission_rate
    description: Share of encounters that are 30-day readmissions (0 in current load).
  -
    name: total_cost_by_encounter_class
    entity: patient_billing_summary
    measure: total_claim_cost
    group_by:
      - encounter_class
    description: Total claim cost by encounter class.
glossary:
  married: marital_status = 'M'
  single: marital_status = 'S'
  divorced: marital_status = 'D'
  widowed: marital_status = 'W'
  living: patient_status = 'ALIVE'
  alive: patient_status = 'ALIVE'
  deceased: patient_status = 'DECEASED'
  dead: patient_status = 'DECEASED'
  hispanic: ethnicity = 'HISPANIC'
  non-hispanic: ethnicity = 'NONHISPANIC'
  doctor: provider_name (patient_clinical_history / patient_billing_summary)
  physician: provider_name
  hospital: organization_name (patient_clinical_history)
  facility: organization_name
  insurer: primary_payer_name / secondary_payer_name (patient_billing_summary)
  payer: primary_payer_name / secondary_payer_name
  readmission: is_30_day_readmission (encounter) / has_30day_readmission_history (patient)
  length of stay: los_days (patient_clinical_history)
  cost: total_claim_cost / total_visit_cost / base_encounter_cost (patient_billing_summary ONLY)
  age: calculated_age (patient_summary)
verified_queries:
  -
    question: How many living patients are there?
    sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS living_patients FROM unity.gold.patient_summary WHERE patient_status = 'ALIVE'
  -
    question: How many patients are there by gender?
    sql: SELECT gender, COUNT(*) AS patient_count FROM unity.gold.patient_summary GROUP BY gender ORDER BY patient_count DESC
  -
    question: What is the average patient age by race?
    sql: SELECT race, ROUND(AVG(calculated_age), 1) AS avg_age FROM unity.gold.patient_summary GROUP BY race ORDER BY avg_age DESC
  -
    question: How many patients have at least one recorded allergy?
    sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS patients_with_allergy FROM unity.gold.patient_summary WHERE has_allergy = TRUE
  -
    question: Who are the five oldest married patients?
    description: Shows mapping 'married' -> marital_status = 'M'.
    sql: SELECT first_name, last_name, calculated_age FROM unity.gold.patient_summary WHERE marital_status = 'M' ORDER BY calculated_age DESC LIMIT 5
  -
    question: How many encounters occurred by encounter class?
    sql: SELECT encounter_class, COUNT(*) AS encounters FROM unity.gold.patient_clinical_history GROUP BY encounter_class ORDER BY encounters DESC
  -
    question: How many distinct patients had an encounter?
    sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT patient_id) AS patients_with_encounter FROM unity.gold.patient_clinical_history
  -
    question: What is the total claim cost by encounter class?
    description: Cost fields live only on patient_billing_summary.
    sql: SELECT encounter_class, ROUND(SUM(total_claim_cost), 2) AS total_claim_cost FROM unity.gold.patient_billing_summary GROUP BY encounter_class ORDER BY total_claim_cost DESC

docs.title: Encounter
docs.text:
[ontology] Encounter
name: Encounter
kind: class
maps_to: unity.gold.patient_clinical_history
synonyms:
  - visit
  - appointment
  - clinical event
semantic_connectivity:
  definition: A single interaction between a patient and the healthcare system.
  business_context: The clinical event grain. Carries denormalized patient/provider/organization names plus per-encounter roll-up counts (conditions, medications, etc.). Cost lives on the sibling billing entity at the same encounter grain.
  intent: Answer 'what happened / how long / how many visits' questions.
attributes:
  -
    name: hasEncounterId
    maps_to: patient_clinical_history.encounter_id
    datatype: string
    identifier: True
    meaning: Encounter natural key (UUID); joins to billing at the same grain.
  -
    name: hasEncounterClass
    maps_to: patient_clinical_history.encounter_class
    datatype: string
    allowed_values:
      - OUTPATIENT
      - EMERGENCY
      - WELLNESS
    meaning: Class/type of encounter (also feeds the Encounter taxonomy).
  -
    name: hasStartDate
    maps_to: patient_clinical_history.start_date
    datatype: timestamp
    meaning: When the encounter started.
  -
    name: hasLengthOfStay
    maps_to: patient_clinical_history.los_days
    datatype: int
    meaning: Length of stay in days (source quirk: observed -5..6).
relations:
  -
    predicate: recordedForPatient
    target: Patient
    inverse: undergoes
    cardinality: many_to_one
    maps_to: patient_clinical_history.patient_id -> patient_summary.patient_id
    meaning: Each encounter belongs to exactly one patient.
  -
    predicate: conductedByProvider
    target: Provider
    inverse: conducts
    cardinality: many_to_one
    maps_to: patient_clinical_history.provider_name
    meaning: Each encounter is conducted by exactly one provider.
  -
    predicate: prescribes
    target: Medication
    cardinality: one_to_many
    maps_to: encounter medication roll-up (medication_count on the encounter)
    meaning: An encounter may prescribe zero or more medications.
  -
    predicate: incursCost
    target: Encounter
    cardinality: one_to_one
    maps_to: patient_billing_summary.encounter_id -> patient_clinical_history.encounter_id
    meaning: Billing/cost shares the encounter grain (join on encounter_id).
constraints:
  -
    id: EN-PK
    kind: key
    rule: encounter_id is unique and not null (primary key).
  -
    id: EN-PATIENT-REQ
    kind: referential
    rule: patient_id is mandatory — an encounter cannot exist without a patient (ENC-HAS-PATIENT).
  -
    id: EN-BILL-11
    kind: cardinality
    rule: Encounter to billing is 1:1 on encounter_id (cost columns live ONLY on billing).

docs.title: Medication
docs.text:
[ontology] Medication
name: Medication
kind: class
maps_to: unity.gold.patient_billing_summary
synonyms:
  - drug
  - therapy
  - prescription drug
semantic_connectivity:
  definition: A therapeutic substance administered to or prescribed for a patient.
  business_context: Medication is a parent concept. Its taxonomy splits into PrescriptionMedication and OTCMedication (see taxonomy/). In the current Gold load medications are sparse (active medications[] is empty on patient_summary), so prefer condition/encounter questions.
  intent: Answer 'what is the patient taking / prescribed' questions and drive drug cohorts.
  reasoning_note: A generic-labelled drug can be reasoned about via its taxonomy (subclass -> physiologic effect) instead of hallucinating — the child concepts carry the extra attributes.
attributes:
  -
    name: hasCode
    maps_to: patient_billing_summary.code
    datatype: string
    identifier: True
    meaning: Medication/drug code (natural key at this grain).
  -
    name: hasName
    maps_to: patient_billing_summary.name
    datatype: string
    meaning: Medication display name.
  -
    name: hasDosage
    maps_to: medication.dosage (silver-derived; see taxonomy children)
    datatype: string
    meaning: Prescribed dose.
  -
    name: hasRoute
    maps_to: medication.route
    datatype: string
    meaning: Route of administration (oral, injectable, ...).
relations:
  -
    predicate: prescribedInEncounter
    target: Encounter
    inverse: prescribes
    cardinality: many_to_one
    maps_to: encounter medication roll-up
    meaning: A medication instance is prescribed within one encounter.
  -
    predicate: takenByPatient
    target: Patient
    inverse: takes
    cardinality: many_to_one
    meaning: A medication is taken by a patient (via the encounter/prescription).
constraints:
  -
    id: MED-PARENT
    kind: taxonomy
    rule: Medication is abstract-ish: concrete instances are classified as PrescriptionMedication or OTCMedication (taxonomy/medication.yml). Filter on the classification first, then attributes.
  -
    id: MED-GRAIN
    kind: modeling
    rule: Do not mix patient-grain and drug-grain data without an explicit relation — join Patient -> Encounter -> Medication rather than pulling drug detail directly onto a patient count.

docs.title: Patient
docs.text:
[ontology] Patient
name: Patient
kind: class
maps_to: unity.gold.patient_summary
synonyms:
  - member
  - individual
  - person
semantic_connectivity:
  definition: A person who receives healthcare services from the organization.
  business_context: The subject of the Patient 360 view. All clinical and financial facts hang off the Patient via patient_id. Demographics are current (SCD2 current version only).
  intent: Answer 'who' questions (counts, demographics, cohort filters) and anchor joins to encounters and medications.
attributes:
  -
    name: hasPatientId
    maps_to: patient_summary.patient_id
    datatype: string
    identifier: True
    meaning: Stable natural key for the patient (UUID).
  -
    name: hasName
    maps_to:
      - patient_summary.first_name
      - patient_summary.last_name
    datatype: string
    phi: True
    meaning: Given/family name. PHI — do not expose in aggregate answers.
  -
    name: hasBirthDate
    maps_to: patient_summary.birth_date
    datatype: date
    meaning: Date of birth; drives calculated_age.
  -
    name: hasStatus
    maps_to: patient_summary.patient_status
    datatype: string
    allowed_values:
      - ALIVE
      - DECEASED
    meaning: Living status of the patient.
  -
    name: hasGender
    maps_to: patient_summary.gender
    datatype: string
    allowed_values:
      - MALE
      - FEMALE
    meaning: Administrative gender.
  -
    name: hasMaritalStatus
    maps_to: patient_summary.marital_status
    datatype: string
    allowed_values:
      - M
      - S
      - D
      - W
    meaning: Single-letter code: M=Married, S=Single, D=Divorced, W=Widowed (null=unknown).
relations:
  -
    predicate: undergoes
    target: Encounter
    inverse: recordedForPatient
    cardinality: one_to_many
    maps_to: patient_clinical_history.patient_id -> patient_summary.patient_id
    meaning: A patient undergoes zero or more encounters over time.
  -
    predicate: takes
    target: Medication
    cardinality: many_to_many
    maps_to: via encounter medications (conceptual; medications[] active-only on patient_summary)
    meaning: A patient takes zero or more active medications.
constraints:
  -
    id: PT-PK
    kind: key
    rule: patient_id is unique and not null (primary key).
  -
    id: PT-ENC-CARD
    kind: cardinality
    rule: A patient may have 0..* encounters; each encounter belongs to exactly 1 patient.
  -
    id: PT-AGE-RANGE
    kind: range
    rule: calculated_age is a non-negative integer (observed 1..112).

docs.title: Provider
docs.text:
[ontology] Provider
name: Provider
kind: class
maps_to: unity.gold.patient_clinical_history
synonyms:
  - doctor
  - physician
  - clinician
  - attending
semantic_connectivity:
  definition: A clinician who delivers care during an encounter.
  business_context: Providers are denormalized onto the encounter (provider_name) rather than a standalone Gold dimension. High cardinality (~261 distinct names in the current load).
  intent: Answer 'by whom' questions and attribute encounters/cost to a clinician.
attributes:
  -
    name: hasProviderName
    maps_to: patient_clinical_history.provider_name
    datatype: string
    meaning: Attending provider name for the encounter.
  -
    name: worksAtOrganization
    maps_to: patient_clinical_history.organization_name
    datatype: string
    meaning: Facility/organization where the encounter took place (~252 distinct).
relations:
  -
    predicate: conducts
    target: Encounter
    inverse: conductedByProvider
    cardinality: one_to_many
    maps_to: patient_clinical_history.provider_name (denormalized on the encounter row)
    meaning: A single provider conducts many encounters (1:N grain).
  -
    predicate: treats
    target: Patient
    cardinality: many_to_many
    maps_to: via Encounter (provider -> encounter -> patient)
    meaning: A provider treats many patients; a patient may see many providers.
constraints:
  -
    id: PR-ENC-CARD
    kind: cardinality
    rule: A provider conducts 0..* encounters; each encounter is conducted by exactly 1 provider.
  -
    id: PR-DENORM
    kind: modeling
    rule: Provider is denormalized (name string), not a keyed dimension — count distinct provider_name for provider-level analytics; there is no provider_id in Gold.

docs.title: patient_360_ontology
docs.text:
[ontology] patient_360_ontology
name: patient_360_ontology
version: 1.0
domain: healthcare
description: Ontology for the Patient 360 domain: Patient, Provider, Encounter and Medication concepts, their attributes, the relations between them (with cardinality), and the constraints that govern how those relations must be read. Grounded to the physical unity.gold.* tables so the AI can move from concept to query without guessing.
global_constraints:
  -
    id: ENC-HAS-PATIENT
    kind: referential
    rule: Every Encounter must be linked to exactly one Patient (patient_id is mandatory).
  -
    id: ENC-HAS-PROVIDER
    kind: referential
    rule: Every Encounter is conducted by exactly one Provider.
  -
    id: BILL-HAS-ENCOUNTER
    kind: referential
    rule: Every billing/claim row must reference an existing Encounter (encounter grain).
  -
    id: PRESCRIPTION-IN-ENCOUNTER
    kind: referential
    rule: Every prescription recorded in an Encounter must be traceable to the Patient of that Encounter (no orphan medication without a patient).
governance:
  owner: Patient 360 Knowledge Engineering (centralized)
  scope: Medication management + clinical encounters for the Patient 360 use case.
  notes:
    - Model key concepts only; do not capture every possible attribute (avoid over-modeling).
    - One canonical definition per concept — no duplicate/competing concepts across teams.
    - Relations connect adjacent granularity levels only (see taxonomy/ for the level hierarchy).

docs.title: EncounterClassTaxonomy
docs.text:
[taxonomy] EncounterClassTaxonomy
name: EncounterClassTaxonomy
root: EncounterClass
entity: Encounter
classification_basis: care setting / acuity
maps_to: unity.gold.patient_clinical_history.encounter_class
description: Groups the flat encounter_class codes into acute vs ambulatory branches so an agent can ask 'how many acute encounters' without enumerating every leaf code. Leaves are the literal values stored in encounter_class; parent nodes are analytic groupings only (not stored values).
nodes:
  -
    concept: EncounterClass
    parent: None
    level: 0
    definition: Top of the encounter classification.
  -
    concept: Ambulatory
    parent: EncounterClass
    level: 1
    definition: Care delivered without an overnight admission.
  -
    concept: Acute
    parent: EncounterClass
    level: 1
    definition: Unplanned / higher-acuity care.
  -
    concept: OUTPATIENT
    parent: Ambulatory
    level: 2
    stored_value: OUTPATIENT
    present_in_data: True
  -
    concept: WELLNESS
    parent: Ambulatory
    level: 2
    stored_value: WELLNESS
    present_in_data: True
  -
    concept: EMERGENCY
    parent: Acute
    level: 2
    stored_value: EMERGENCY
    present_in_data: True
  -
    concept: INPATIENT
    parent: Acute
    level: 2
    stored_value: INPATIENT
    present_in_data: False
    note: In the domain but absent from the current load.
  -
    concept: URGENTCARE
    parent: Acute
    level: 2
    stored_value: URGENTCARE
    present_in_data: False
    note: In the domain but absent from the current load.
usage_note: To answer 'acute encounters', filter encounter_class IN ('EMERGENCY','INPATIENT','URGENTCARE'); for 'ambulatory', IN ('OUTPATIENT','WELLNESS'). Only OUTPATIENT/WELLNESS/EMERGENCY are populated.

docs.title: patient_360_taxonomy
docs.text:
[taxonomy] patient_360_taxonomy
name: patient_360_taxonomy
version: 1.0
domain: healthcare
description: Classification hierarchies for the Patient 360 ontology: the Medication tree (Prescription vs OTC, and the ingredient granularity ladder) and the Encounter-class tree (acute vs ambulatory).
purpose:
  - Classify-then-drill: reason about the category before the specific entity.
  - Granularity control: every relation connects adjacent levels at the same grain.
  - Drift mitigation: new child concepts inherit the parent without retraining (consumed via RAG).
governance:
  owner: Patient 360 Knowledge Engineering (centralized)
  watchouts:
    - Avoid duplicate/competing classifications across teams — one tree per concept.
    - Do not mix aggregated and detail grains without an intervening level (inconsistent granularity).

docs.title: MedicationTaxonomy
docs.text:
[taxonomy] MedicationTaxonomy
name: MedicationTaxonomy
root: Medication
entity: Medication
classification_basis: regulatory / dispensing class
description: Medication is the parent concept; PrescriptionMedication and OTCMedication are child concepts that inherit Medication's attributes (code, name, dosage, route) and add their own. Classify a drug into a child first, then apply child-specific attributes.
nodes:
  -
    concept: Medication
    parent: None
    level: 0
    maps_to: unity.gold.patient_billing_summary
    definition: Any therapeutic drug prescribed for or taken by a patient.
    attributes:
      - hasCode
      - hasName
      - hasDosage
      - hasRoute
  -
    concept: PrescriptionMedication
    parent: Medication
    level: 1
    criteria: Requires a prescriber's order (an rxNumber / prescription exists).
    inherits:
      - hasCode
      - hasName
      - hasDosage
      - hasRoute
    adds:
      -
        name: hasRxNumber
        datatype: string
        identifier: True
        meaning: Prescription order number.
      -
        name: hasPrescriber
        datatype: string
        meaning: Ordering provider.
      -
        name: hasRefills
        datatype: int
        meaning: Authorised refills remaining.
    synonyms:
      - prescription drug
      - Rx
      - prescribed medication
  -
    concept: OTCMedication
    parent: Medication
    level: 1
    criteria: Available without a prescription (over-the-counter).
    inherits:
      - hasCode
      - hasName
      - hasDosage
      - hasRoute
    adds:
      -
        name: hasUpc
        datatype: string
        identifier: True
        meaning: Retail UPC/barcode.
      -
        name: hasBrand
        datatype: string
        meaning: Consumer brand name.
      -
        name: hasRetailer
        datatype: string
        meaning: Point of sale / retailer.
    synonyms:
      - over-the-counter
      - OTC
      - non-prescription
granularity_ladder:
  - Patient  -> hasPrescription -> Prescription
  - Prescription -> prescribes -> Drug          (e.g. Tylenol, Ibuprofen)
  - Drug -> contains -> ActiveIngredient         (e.g. acetaminophen, ibuprofen)
usage_note: For 'which patients take a drug containing acetaminophen', filter at the ActiveIngredient level and join UP to Patient — return patient-grain rows, not the drug detail.

docs.title: patient_360_data_contracts
docs.text:
[data_contract] patient_360_data_contracts
name: patient_360_data_contracts
version: 1.0
standard: ODCS-inspired (Open Data Contract Standard)
description: Serving contracts for the three Patient 360 Gold tables. Each contract carries SLA + timing metadata (so an AI does not draw wrong conclusions from stale joins) and a semantic-versioning policy for schema evolution.
versioning_policy:
  scheme: semver
  major: Breaking change — column removed/renamed, type narrowed, or the MEANING of a value changes.
  minor: Additive, backward-compatible — new column or new allowed value.
  patch: Docs/metadata only — descriptions, tags, SLA text.
  deprecation: Announce a breaking change at least one MINOR release ahead; keep the prior MAJOR readable during the deprecation window; AI-assisted migration handles downstream rewrites.
  breaking_change_notation: Increment MAJOR and tag the changelog entry `BREAKING`.

docs.title: patient_billing_summary
docs.text:
[data_contract] patient_billing_summary
kind: DataContract
id: patient_billing_summary
version: 1.0.0
status: active
table: unity.gold.patient_billing_summary
domain: finance
owner: Patient 360 Data Engineering
schema_ref: contracts/patient_billing_summary.yml
ontology_ref: ontology/entities/medication.yml
semantic_ref: semantic/entities/patient_billing_summary.yml
description: Encounter-grain financials — the ONLY Gold table that carries cost columns (DRD 5.5 isolation). Claims are left-joined, so multiple claims per encounter can fan out rows.
guarantees:
  grain: one row per encounter (claims left-joined; claim fan-out possible)
  primary_key: encounter_id
  foreign_keys:
    - patient_id -> patient_summary.patient_id
    - encounter_id -> patient_clinical_history.encounter_id (1:1)
  cost_isolation: total_claim_cost / base_encounter_cost / total_visit_cost exist ONLY here.
  counting_rule: Use COUNT(DISTINCT encounter_id) to avoid claim fan-out double counting.
sla:
  update_frequency: Rebuilt each gold_build run.
  freshness: Full-overwrite current snapshot.
  latency: Available immediately after gold_build completes.
  availability: Best-effort on the local dev stack; production target 99.5%.
  retention: Current snapshot only.
  timing_caveats:
    - In the current load only cost fields carry values; claim_id, payer names, claim_status, service_date and outstanding_amount are null/zero — payer analytics return nothing.
consumers:
  - Patient 360 dashboard (cost KPIs)
  - NL-to-SQL analytics agent (AI Analytics Query)
changelog:
  -
    version: 1.0.0
    change: Initial contract.
    breaking: False

[data_contract] patient_clinical_history
kind: DataContract
id: patient_clinical_history
version: 1.0.0
status: active
table: unity.gold.patient_clinical_history
domain: analytics
owner: Patient 360 Data Engineering
schema_ref: contracts/patient_clinical_history.yml
ontology_ref: ontology/entities/encounter.yml
semantic_ref: semantic/entities/patient_clinical_history.yml
description: One row per clinical encounter with denormalized patient/provider/organization names and per-encounter roll-up counts. Encounter-grain consumer surface (joins 1:1 to billing).
guarantees:
  grain: one row per encounter
  primary_key: encounter_id
  foreign_keys:
    - patient_id -> patient_summary.patient_id (mandatory)
  joins:
    - encounter_id 1:1 to patient_billing_summary (cost lives only on billing)
sla:
  update_frequency: Rebuilt each gold_build run.
  freshness: Full-overwrite current snapshot.
  latency: Available immediately after gold_build completes.
  availability: Best-effort on the local dev stack; production target 99.5%.
  retention: Current snapshot only.
  timing_caveats:
    - Downstream joins to nightly-refreshed sources (e.g. a 3 AM lab feed) can lag encounter data: an encounter recorded late in the day may not have matching same-day lab results yet. Do not conclude 'no result' before the next refresh — treat a missing join as pending, not negative.
consumers:
  - Patient 360 dashboard
  - NL-to-SQL analytics agent (AI Analytics Query)
changelog:
  -
    version: 1.0.0
    change: Initial contract.
    breaking: False

  timing_caveats:
